summary: Bitdeer Technologies Group filed Form 6-K to report its May 2026 production and operations update. The filing is a routine monthly update from the foreign private issuer, disclosing operational metrics such as Bitcoin production (921 BTC, up 370% Y/Y), self-mining hash rate (70.2 EH/s), AI Cloud ARR (~$69M), and colocation negotiations for Tydal, Norway. No special-situation event like a merger, tender offer, or strategic transaction is announced. The filing describes normal business operations and progress in AI and mining infrastructure. Therefore, this is a standard operational report, not a special situation.
